title: Ishqnama Box Office Collection Day 3: With 40% Jump, Shehnaaz Gill Starrer Records 3rd Highest Opening Weekend In Punjabi In 2026!
summary: Ishqnama jumped 40% on day 3 to collect 1.4 crore net, taking its India opening weekend to 3.20 crore net and the 3rd highest opening weekend for Punjabi cinema in 2026. Word-of-mouth is strong and gross including taxes stands at 3.77 crore. Reportedly made on a budget of over 20 crore, the film needs sustained momentum to reach breakeven amid limited competition from Carry On Jatta 4.
content:
Arvindr Khaira’s Punjabi romantic period drama Ishqnama has packed a fair opening weekend. Shehnaaz Gill and Jayy Randhawa starrer surpassed Bambukat 2 to score the 3rd highest opening weekend of 2026 in Punjabi cinema.

According to the latest update, Ishqnama collected 1.4 crore net on day 3 of its box office run in India. It witnessed a 40% jump after earning 1 crore on Saturday. The word-of-mouth is excellent, which kept the footfalls coming throughout the first weekend. With little competition from Carry On Jatta 4, all eyes are now on the Monday test.

The total collection in India stands at 3.20 crore net after the opening weekend. While there’s no official confirmation, Ishqnama is reportedly made on a budget of over 20 crore. It must maintain strong momentum hereon to reach breakeven and enter the safe zone. Including taxes, the gross earnings have reached 3.77 crore.

Total: 3.20 crore

Shehnaaz Gill and Jayy Randhawa’s film recorded the 3rd biggest opening weekend of Punjabi cinema in 2026. It stayed only behind Carry On Jatta 4 and Rabb Da Radio 3. Ishqan Da Lekhe (1.60 crore) is now out of the top 5.
